verdict.rationale: Paperspace's API-key docs name an official "Core JavaScript SDK" alongside the REST API and CLI, so a first-party SDK exists. Beyond that one mention, the pack has no SDK documentation, install instructions, language coverage or maintenance status. The REST API, OpenAPI spec and CLI are adjacent interfaces, not SDKs. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation, SDKs for additional languages (e.g. Python), evidence the SDK is current and maintained, and hands-on or independent corroboration of building against it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).
